MCP-compatible code editor?Run npx -y firecrawl-mcp to install the official Firecrawl MCP server, then add the configuration to your editor's MCP settings file with your API key. Most developers are set up in under 3 minutes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible editor. Full setup guide at docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp-server.Does Firecrawl work with Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf?Yes. Firecrawl provides an official MCP server that works with any MCP-compatible editor including Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. Install once and use across all your editors. The same MCP server works everywhere.Can I use Firecrawl for free to prototype my AI agent?Yes. The free tier includes 10 scrapes per minute, 10 maps per minute, 5 searches per minute, and 1 crawl per minute. No credit card required to start. You can build and test your agent before upgrading to a paid plan.What data formats does Firecrawl return for AI agents?Firecrawl returns clean markdown and structured JSON, optimized for LLMs. All content is pre-processed to remove ads, navigation, footers, and boilerplate. Your agent gets only the signal, not the noise. You can also request raw HTML if needed.Can I use Firecrawl in production with my code editor?Absolutely. Firecrawl powers AI agents and code editors at companies like Replit. Our infrastructure handles millions of requests daily with 99.9% uptime (status.firecrawl.dev). Start on the free tier and scale to production without changing your code.What happens when websites change or block requests?Firecrawl handles website changes, anti-bot protection, and dynamic JavaScript rendering automatically. You never maintain headless browsers, rotate proxies, or update selectors. We handle the infrastructure so you can focus on building your agent.What is Firecrawl's scrape quality and coverage like?The world's most comprehensive context API for the web. Our custom browser stack and semantic index deliver superior data quality across any website, handling more content types and edge cases than any competitor.How does Firecrawl handle complex websites?JavaScript rendering, dynamic content, and robust request handling built-in.Can Firecrawl scrape at enterprise scale?Process millions of pages with automatic rate limiting, caching, and distributed infrastructure.How fast is Firecrawl scraping?Optimized scraping engine with parallel processing and smart caching for instant results.Is Firecrawl built for developers?Comprehensive docs, SDKs for all major languages, and dedicated support to help you succeed.The easiest way to get context from the web
